method: Alpha-weighted center plus occupied alpha-mask blocks; compare entire projected tree footprint to shared displaced river-distance field, including bank gap. Reject overlapping candidates; retain root anchors and depth sorting.
tests: 8 tests passed. Actual-sprite browser diagnostic: 1258 channel-center samples, zero obscured (RGB tolerance 8). Chrome render and export verified; no captured browser errors.
limitations: Current clearance rejects trees rather than relocating them and may leave a visibly open bank corridor. Coverage uses 2px alpha blocks with conservative padding and is not a general collision system for mountains or resources.
